title: Back Rooms, and I remembered Something that seems important
content: Dream started in an old bedroom I had when I was a teen, I broke it off with this guy I was seeing for a bit and got a notification he was making a $90 pizza on my phone using my card so I got annoyed and started looking for him and knew he was in the “attic”. Of course, this particular house in real life doesn’t have an attic btw. As soon as I left my room what was my house turned into a series of endless hallways that seemed homey enough, carpeted and stuff, until I got to the attic door which was an irregular shaped wooden door. I opened it and was surprised to see not an attic but more endless hallways that were now commercial looking… and in front of me a commercial door with a peek window and some women poking their head up to look at me and running away. at that point I got a terrifyingly creepy feeling, so started looking for an exit. Of course I couldn’t find one and traversed the hallways for a long time passing old retro display cases for a cafe as well as an out of commission retro popcorn maker, seemed like a storage unit for all the unused stuff in mall world. At one point I turn around and see a security guard that has been staring at me, standing next to a GameCube. I immediately knew what I had to do to “exit” the dream, so I walked up to him and the GameCube and pressed the power button to turn the dream off, and started walking away quickly from him. He started running after me and I kept consciously telling myself “wake tf up” until I did as the hallways started falling away and becoming completely empty with just this security guard dude following me. What is so interesting about this is, this is the first backrooms dream I remember, but it unlocked the memory of trying to turn off so many dreams by pressing the power button on my GameCube or having the sensation within a dream like “quick quick press the power button.” so weird guys, this is so weird and I’m so happy we come together to share our experiences on Reddit. I’ve moved to my living room to lay on couch because I’m spooked right now but knowing you guys experience this often makes me feel less alone. Lolllll
